"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be NumPy arrays.")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must be 2-dimensional.")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must have the same shape.")
    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("All input values must be finite.")
    if (logp_with_result > 0).any() or (logp_call_only > 0).any() or (logp_no_call > 0).any():
        raise ValueError("All input values must be nonpositive (<= 0).")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number and not boolean.")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Use the stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Compute margin and apply threshold (T04)
    margin = loss_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
